audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Lucian levels 1-5 and called 6 onward Skill, while the whys beside those rows say she takes the lane from level 3 and hard-outscales.
audit.why: 40% win rate and the packet chart (Lucian/Skill/Cassiopeia x5) agree with the prose. The mirror slice saw the same disagreement and left it for a mirror-fix pass; the rows are the thing that is wrong, so I fixed them here.
audit.corrected: Row 1 to Skill, rows 2-6 to Cassiopeia, in matched full/content pairs with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item carried generic Culling and kill-window copy.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s at 825 range; Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and falls to 16s; Noxious Blast is a 3.5s cooldown, so her poke never really goes away.
audit.corrected: Rows now name the real cooldowns and what each spike actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze was described as an unconditional face-stun and Twin Fang's healing never reached the page.
audit.why: Riot's text: Petrifying Gaze stuns enemies in front of her that are FACING her, and merely slows anyone with their back turned — turning away is the counterplay, and it is the one interaction that decides the level-6 all-in. Twin Fang (0.75s cooldown) deals increased damage to poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage.
audit.corrected: Facing requirement stated in phases[4].why, whys[4] and wants.you[1]; Twin Fang's heal added with Grievous Wounds timing. Miasma's grounding of Relentless Pursuit kept and tied to real numbers.

edits.before: E online — dash-weave trades start now: spell, double-shot, dash out before his answer lands.
edits.after: Q + Lightslinger still wins level 2, but Noxious Blast's poison sustain makes it even, not free.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-AA-E-AA-W-AA strings chunk a third of his HP. Trade on every CS he takes from the wrong angle.
edits.after: Miasma (24s at rank 1) grounds Relentless Pursuit — dash into it and you are stranded inside her poison.

edits.before: Keep the pressure rolling but track Miasma — your lead is HP-bar bullying, not all-in math, until items arrive.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her for a share of every poisoned hit — buy Grievous Wounds before you contest another trade.

edits.before: The Culling adds lane-clear and execute chip — use it through walls on recalls and low-HP escapes.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze stuns only what faces her — turn your back as it casts and you take the slow instead.

edits.before: First item spike is your kill window — the dash-weave combo now deletes half bars. Force the issue before he stabilizes.
edits.after: Her first AP item chunks your low HP while Miasma grounds your exit — no spike out-races a 3.5-second Noxious Blast.

edits.before: You fall off relative to top-lane scalers — convert the lead into towers and roams before the 3-item brawlers arrive.
edits.after: Serpentine Grace makes every move-speed buy stronger on her, so she kites you out and poison finishes what grounding starts.

edits.before: That’s Cassiopeia’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her for a share of the damage — chip poke just feeds it.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia’s Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Miasma (24s at rank 1): grounded means Relentless Pursuit is dead — never enter the cloud with E as your exit.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze face-stuns you mid-Culling, wasting your ult and letting her free-cast a full poison rotation.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (120s) stuns you only if you face it — turn away and you take a slow instead of a lost Culling.

edits.before: Bait her R Petrifying Gaze sideways so it misses, THEN commit Q-W-E and Culling
edits.after: Turn your back as Petrifying Gaze casts — facing her is the stun, turned away is only a slow

notes: Petrifying Gaze only stuns targets that are FACING her; the page treated it as an unconditional stun, which changes the entire level-6 decision. Packet suspectName "Hold Petrifying Gaze" is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct Riot name. Chart flipped to the packet in both layers; the mirror slice deliberately left Cassiopeia's side unflipped, so mirror-fix may need a pass to keep the two directions agreeing.
